summary: Iteration 24 verified the fix removing auth requirement from POST /api/payments/validate-discount. Backend: 5/5 pytest in test_iteration24.py — (1) guest validates open 10% code TMPLAUNCH10 against a 1000₺ cart and gets discount=100, total=900; (2) guest invalid code returns 400 'Geçersiz indirim kodu'; (3) guest restricted code (course_ids=[B]) rejected for cart containing course A -> 400; (4) same restricted code accepted when cart contains course B (15% of 500 = 75); (5) admin session also still validates successfully (regression). No 401 observed. All test data cleaned up (TMPLAUNCH10/TMPRESTRICT10 deleted; no leftovers).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_payments.validate_discount now accepts anonymous requests (no get_current_user call). Signature kept request: Request for future rate-limit hooks — fine.

Checkout.jsx auto-apply .catch(() => {}) still swallows 400s silently (e.g., when guest cart doesn't match restricted code). Consider surfacing a soft message so launch-link visitors learn their code is not valid for their cart. Not blocking.
No new rate limiting on /payments/validate-discount — endpoint is public and performs a Mongo lookup. Low risk (indexed by code), but worth noting if traffic spikes.
CourseDetail.jsx stores kod unconditionally in localStorage; code is validated server-side at checkout so safe.
